title: Enterprise Support: Spending-to-hours conversion for physical-quantity reconciliation
content:
Enterprise Support — Spending-to-hours conversion for physical-quantity reconciliation.

## Decision basis

For physical-quantity reconciliation: Convert recognized eligible supported spending in USD back to equivalent vCPU-hours by dividing by the positive effective cloud rate; if the rate is zero the equivalent contribution is zero.

## Hypothetical case

For physical-quantity reconciliation: A hypothetical USD 48 recognized contribution at a positive effective rate of USD 0.40 represents 120 vCPU-hours. If the effective rate is zero, the equivalent recognized contribution is zero.
